description:
Deal combat damage using Ant-Man, triggering its ability, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Mm'menon triggers that many times, putting at least five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.name: Ant-Man, Elusive Avenger
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater
